title: 1801 Prairie's east range gets its second gabled bay
items: Along 18th Street, the Kimball house's lower east range now has a second stone bay between the corner turret and the side door, rising through the eave to a pinnacled gable, as the 1965 survey photograph shows it.
The range's eaves no longer run across the faces of its two gabled bays, so both rise clear and their upper windows show.
